d:
Yas Lions roar loud with a 13-run victory over United Tigers!
Batting first, Yas Lions posted a competitive 115/5 in 10 overs, with Tom Moores anchoring the innings with an unbeaten 33 off just 18 balls.
In reply, United Tigers managed 102/5 despite their efforts, as Karim Janat led a disciplined bowling performance to help the Lions defend their total and seal a 13-run win!
